description:
剣：不出来な刀。
\C[24]武器スキル：\C[0]なし<EN>Sword: A poorly made blade. \C[24]Weapon Skill: \C[0]None
name: 鈍刀<EN>Dull Sword
note:
<dPlnText:A crude, dull blade. Unreliable as a weapon for hunting
aberrations. A sword that cannot cut has no value. Best to
replace it sooner rather than later. It has no special
effects.>

description:
剣：シキノワの一般的な武器。
\C[24]武器スキル：\C[0]袈裟斬り<EN>Sword: A common weapon in Shikinowa. \C[24]Weapon Skill: \C[0]Diagonal Slash
name: 無銘打刀<EN>Unsigned Sword
note:
<dPlnText:A type of sword called a katana. A common weapon in the
eastern lands. Outsiders often expect extraordinary
sharpness from them, but an ordinary katana is nothing
special. It has no special effects.>

description:
剣：シキノワの都で売られている土産物。
\C[24]武器スキル：\C[0]袈裟斬り<EN>Sword: A souvenir sold in the capital of Shikinowa. \C[24]Weapon Skill: \C[0]Diagonal Slash
name: 秋水京土産刀<EN>Shusui Kyoto Souvenir Sword
note:
<dPlnText:An eastern katana. A souvenir, but it cuts well. Some
adventurers are oddly fond of katanas. This one was made
with that demand in mind. It has no special effects.>

description:
剣：砕けた陽鉄から鍛えられた刀。
\C[24]武器スキル：\C[0]袈裟斬り<EN>Sword: A blade forged from shattered Yotetsu. \C[24]Weapon Skill: \C[0]Diagonal Slash
name: 陽鉄屑刀<EN>Yotetsu Scrap Sword
note:
<dPlnText:A katana found at the eastern edge. Said to be crafted by
mystic tanuki. Yotetsu is a blessing from Meikoku Mountain,
and even in fragments, it serves as high-quality weapon
material. It has no special effects.>

description:
剣：遥か昔からウパシモシリで作られる武器。
\C[24]武器スキル：\C[0]袈裟斬り<EN>Sword: A weapon crafted in Upashimoshiri since ancient times. \C[24]Weapon Skill:
\C[0]Diagonal Slash
name: 祭事の剣<EN>Ritual Sword
note:
<dPlnText:A weapon found in Upashimoshiri. Distinguished by its white-and-black hilt.
Long ago, before the name of Kamuy was even known, there was a festival in
the snowy village to honor souls. It has been passed down as a sacred rite,
and under the name of Seseku, even the ceremonial tools remain,
undiminished. It has no special effects.>

description:
剣：神派の戦士が扱う武器。
\C[24]武器スキル：\C[0]神の癒し<EN>Sword: A weapon wielded by warriors of the Divine Faction. \C[24]Weapon Skill: \C[0]Divine
Healing
name: アドシアンソード<EN>Adosian Sword
note:
<dPlnText:A weapon from Ramla Aram. Gear of the Aswad Warriors. To
survive the harsh desert, it is imbued with the god's mercy
and healing prayers. It has no special effects.>

description:
剣：名だたる刀匠の駄作。
\C[24]武器スキル：\C[0]冷まし<EN>Sword: A failure from a renowned swordsmith. \C[24]Weapon Skill: \C[0]Cooling
name: 空風<EN>Sky Wind
note:
<NameColor:23>
<dPlnText:A work by the renowned swordsmith, Hohara Haruhi. Its name is read as
Karakaze. That single stroke cools the heat like an empty wind, and
swiftly saps the enemy's will to fight. It could be called an exceptional
blade, but the master genius was not fully satisfied. Has the following
special effects: ・Critical rate +3%>

description:
\C[24]【ナズナ専用】\C[0]剣：真白神社に祀られている神器。
\C[24]武器スキル：\C[0]悪斬<EN>\C[24][Nazuna Only]\C[0]Sword: A sacred treasure enshrined at Mashiro Shrine. \C[24]Weapon
Skill: \C[0]Evil Slash
name: カンムイの剣<EN>Kamui's Sword
note:
<追加武器タイプ:7>
<NameColor:23>
<dPlnText:A treasure of the Mashiro Shrine. A fragment of the bone of that great
aberration. Kamuy once rent the clouds and called down lightning. Even in
its remains, a trace of that power lingers. The coming storm is a divine
thunderbolt, striking down the corruption spreading in the east. Has the
following special effects: ・Adds lightning attribute to attacks>

description:
剣：足袋蛇の長の得物の片割れ。
\C[24]武器スキル：\C[0]這う牙<EN>Sword: One half of the chief of the Tabigami Snake's paired weapons. \C[24]Weapon
Skill: \C[0]Creeping Fang
name: 龍断ちの一隻<EN>Dragon Slayer
note:
<NameColor:23>
<dPlnText:A strange, distorted and elongated tachi. Its blade resembles a serpent.
The ambitions of eight sacrificed all their kin, but one survived on sheer
obsession alone. At the bottom of the abyss, the ninth serpent, now an
incarnation of hatred that has cast aside even its name, never desired
betrayal in the first place. Has the following special effects: ・Adds dark
attribute to attacks ・Critical rate +15%>

description:
剣：鵺の力をも切るという剣。
\C[24]武器スキル：\C[0]袈裟斬り<EN>Sword: A blade said to be capable of cutting even the Nue's power. \C[24]Weapon Skill:
\C[0]Diagonal Slash
name: 鵺切<EN>Nue Slayer
note:
<NameColor:23>
<dPlnText:A sword that severed the power of wandering. At the same time, its own
wandering was also lost. It is now a weapon without special abilities, but
it is without a doubt a masterpiece by Hohara Haruhi, and its sharpness
itself could be called its specialty. It has no special effects.>

description:
剣：左雨家に代々伝わる武器。
\C[24]武器スキル：\C[0]鋭い刺突<EN>Sword: A weapon passed down through the Sayuu family for generations. \C[24]Weapon
Skill: \C[0]Sharp Thrust
name: 黒雨<EN>Black Rain
note:
<BoostEX:CR, 20>
<NameColor:23>
<dPlnText:A weapon wielded by the regent of the Shogun Clan. Its name is read as
Kokuu. A gift from the Hohara clan―or perhaps a curse. Its unnaturally
keen point sometimes puts an end to the maddened master's very breath. It
makes one ponder that resolve. Has the following special effects: ・Critical
damage +20%>

description:
剣：観光の記念品となっている武器。
\C[24]武器スキル：\C[0]アル・ヘルムの斬撃<EN>Sword: A weapon sold as a souvenir for tourists. \C[24]Weapon Skill: \C[0]Al-Helm's Slash
name: アル・ヘルムの剣<EN>Al-Helm's Sword
note:
<NameColor:23>
<dPlnText:Equipment created by the technology of the Human Faction. Its true value is
realized through Roof. A weapon to oppose destruction, and even its high
performance is by no means excessive. For some reason, it's treated as a
commemorative item. Quite unexpected. Has the following special effects:
・All stats +3%>

description:
剣：実体のない刃を持つ武器。
\C[24]武器スキル：\C[0]デミルーメン<EN>Sword: A weapon with an incorporeal blade. \C[24]Weapon Skill: \C[0]Demilumen
name: レーザーブレード<EN>Laser Blade
note:
<NameColor:31>
<dPlnText:Equipment obtained from the Master. It houses high performance. It was made
as a weapon of Orsa, but now it served as a convenient light source. Has
the following special effects: ・Adds light attribute to attacks ・Attack +5%>

description:
剣：鍛錬神事にて捧げられる武器。
\C[24]武器スキル：\C[0]真白御利益<EN>Sword: A weapon offered during the Forging Ritual. \C[24]Weapon Skill: \C[0]Pure White
Blessing
name: 真白御剣<EN>Pure White Sacred Sword
note:
<BoostEX:CR, 10>
<NameColor:2>
<dPlnText:A weapon passed down at the Mashiro Shrine. Offered during the Forging
Rite. Hakutō's sword, so powerful that it was said to break with every
battle. In the Forging Rite, gratitude is offered to the god who protects
the people, and a worthy new weapon is presented. Has the following special
effects: ・Critical rate +10% ・Critical damage +10%>

description:
剣：四魂怪異、百王柴鬼の魂を宿す武器。
\C[24]武器スキル：\C[0]堅牢化<EN>Sword: A weapon harboring the soul of the Four-Soul Anomaly, Hyakuro Saiki.
\C[24]Weapon Skill: \C[0]Fortification
name: 百王太刀<EN>Hundred Kings' Sword
note:
<NameColor:2>
<dPlnText:Woven from the soul of the Four-Soul Aberration. It inherits a fragment of
its power. Shiba Dōji, in life, forged many weapons, and every one of them
was an excellent piece. Has the following special effects: ・Adds ice
attribute to attacks ・Attack +10% ・Defense +20%>

description:
剣：四魂怪異、五尾夕闇の魂を宿す武器。
\C[24]武器スキル：\C[0]妖し艶火<EN>Sword: A weapon harboring the soul of the Four-Soul Anomaly, Goo Yuuyami. \C[24]Weapon
Skill: \C[0]Bewitching Flame
name: 艶尾炎剣<EN>Gleaming Tail Flame Sword
note:
<NameColor:2>
<dPlnText:Woven from the soul of the Four-Soul Aberration. It inherits a fragment of
its power. Tales of Yuuyami are particularly numerous among the Four-Soul
Aberrations. So much so that it captivated the masses. Has the following
special effects: ・Adds fire attribute to attacks ・Magic attack +10% ・Magic
defense +20%>

description:
剣：四魂怪異、妖狸隠神の魂を宿す武器。
\C[24]武器スキル：\C[0]八八大騒動<EN>Sword: A weapon harboring the soul of the Four-Soul Anomaly, Youri
Inugami. \C[24]Weapon Skill: \C[0]Eighty-Eight Uproar
name: 八八刃<EN>Eighty-Eight Blade
note:
<NameColor:2>
<dPlnText:Woven from the soul of the Four-Soul Aberration. It inherits a fragment of
its power. Once, people feared the darkness of night, but at some point, a
cheerful chant dispelled it. Has the following special effects: ・Adds earth
attribute to attacks ・Max HP +10% ・Spirit +20%>

description:
剣：四魂怪異、鵺の魂を宿す武器。
\C[24]武器スキル：\C[0]蛟の連剣<EN>Sword: A weapon harboring the soul of the Four-Soul Anomaly, Nue. \C[24]Weapon Skill:
\C[0]Serpent's Chain Sword
name: 不詳の剣<EN>Unknown Sword
note:
<NameColor:2>
<BoostEX:WT, 1, 10>
<dPlnText:Woven from the soul of the Four-Soul Aberration. It inherits
a fragment of its power. The very existence of Nue has long
been doubted, but she was certainly there. Has the following
special effects: ・All attack power +10%>

description:
短剣：護身用の短い刀。
\C[24]武器スキル：\C[0]鋭い刺突<EN>Dagger: A short blade for self-defense. \C[24]Weapon Skill: \C[0]Sharp Thrust
name: 短刀<EN>Short Sword
note:
<dPlnText:A short sword kept in the bosom. Many carry it for
self-defense. If you seize an opening and strike a vital
spot, it can deal a fatal blow even to aberrations. Has the
following special effects: ・Critical rate +1%>

description:
短剣：忍びが持つものとして売られている武器。
\C[24]武器スキル：\C[0]鋭い刺突<EN>Dagger: A weapon sold as something a shinobi would carry. \C[24]Weapon Skill: \C[0]Sharp
Thrust
name: 忍びの短刀<EN>Ninja's Short Sword
note:
<dPlnText:An eastern short sword. A souvenir, but it cuts well. Some
adventurers misunderstand ninja, thinking they are magicians
or something. Has the following special effects: ・Critical
rate +1%>

description:

短剣：不気味な刀。折れているが、まだ使える。
\C[24]武器スキル：\C[0]不浄臍帯<EN>Dagger: An eerie blade. It's broken, but still usable. \C[24]Weapon Skill: \C[0]Impure
Umbilical Cord
name: 折れた奇喰<EN>Broken Kikui
note:
<NameColor:23>
<dPlnText:A katana broken in half. Its name is read as Kushigui. A cursed object
left by the Hohara clan, it was guarded by the monk Dōtoku of Seihō Temple.
Defiled, it is now but a shadow of its former self. Has the following
special effects: ・Recover 4% HP each turn>

description:
短剣：足袋蛇一族の武器。
\C[24]武器スキル：\C[0]抉り<EN>Dagger: A weapon of the Tabi Snake clan. \C[24]Weapon Skill: \C[0]Gouge
name: 足袋蛇の波打ち刃<EN>Tabi Snake's Rippling Blade
note:
<NameColor:23>
<dPlnText:A relic of the Tabihebi clan. Characterized by its undulating blade. In an
age when humans and aberrations stood in opposition, there was a snake with
legs in the valley depths. Has the following special effects: ・Adds ice
attribute to attacks ・Critical rate +3%>

description:
短剣：神の都を離れた一団の暗殺武器。
\C[24]武器スキル：\C[0]暗殺<EN>Dagger: An assassination weapon of a group that left the Divine Capital. \C[24]Weapon
Skill: \C[0]Assassination
name: 虚無派の刃<EN>Void Faction Blade
note:
<NameColor:23>
<dPlnText:A jet-black dagger. It reflects no light and blends into darkness. A people
who praised the gods, and yet also believed in human potential― the one who
could not accept the harmony of both found no place in the light. Has the
following special effects: ・Critical rate +25%>

\C[24]武器スキル：\C[0]アル・ヘルムの斬撃<EN>Dagger: A weapon sold as a tourist souvenir. \C[24]Weapon Skill: \C[0]Al-Helm's Slash

\C[24]武器スキル：\C[0]なし<EN>Dagger: The horn of an Oni from Meikoku Mountain. \C[24]Weapon Skill: \C[0]None
name: 頂の鬼の角<EN>Oni Horn of the Summit
note:
<NameColor:31>
<dPlnText:Woven from the soul of the Master. It inherits a fragment of its power. The
horn is hot, bearing the power of flame. It is a blessing gained from
basking in the sun. Has the following special effects: ・Adds fire attribute
to attacks ・Attack +20%>

description:

\C[24]武器スキル：\C[0]振り回し<EN>Greatsword: A huge wooden sword. \C[24]Weapon Skill: \C[0]Sweep
name: 大木刀<EN>Great Wooden Sword
note:
<dPlnText:An enormous wooden sword that's too big to wield with both
hands. Used by a monster that prides itself on strength. It
delivers power matching its weight, but Agility will likely
be compromised. Has no special effects.>

description:
大剣：鬼が振るうとされる鉈。
\C[24]武器スキル：\C[0]振り回し<EN>Greatsword: A billhook said to be wielded by Oni. \C[24]Weapon Skill: \C[0]Sweep
name: 大鉈<EN>Great Hatchet
note:
<dPlnText:A souvenir marketed as the weapon of the Eastern monster,
the Oni. The sales pitch seems dubious, but that aside, it
can serve as a weapon. Has no special effects.>

note:
<NameColor:23>
<dPlnText:A weapon formed by chance from a shattered boulder. It
resembles a sword. This too must be some kind of fate. You
can rely on it―though its weight will wipe the smile off
your face. Has the following special effects: ・Agility -50%>

description:
大剣：盾としても機能する大剣。
\C[24]武器スキル：\C[0]防御態勢<EN>Greatsword: A greatsword that also functions as a shield. \C[24]Weapon Skill:
\C[0]Defensive Stance
